optimizedContext.value:
# language-adapter

## Rules

### Port + lifecycle
- `LanguageAdapter` interface; stateless, synchronous, deterministic. `languages()`, `extensions()`, `resolutionManifests()`, `analyzeFile(filePath, content, context)`, `resolveImports(analysis, context)`, `buildRelations(analysis, context)`; optional `getPackageIdentity?`, `resolvePackageFromSpecifier?`, `resolveQualifiedNameToPath?`.
- `resolutionManifests(): readonly string[]`: exact manifest basenames, no globs/paths/I/O; `[]` if none. TypeScript returns `["package.json"]`.
- `analyzeFile` single parse → complete compact `FileAnalysisDraft`: symbols, imports, bindings, calls, namespace, optional serializable parser state; no AST/parser retention. No legacy extraction path. TS/JS, PHP, Python, Go all unified.
- `resolveImports`/`buildRelations`: stored facts + `IndexSession`; Pass 2 no content re-read, whole-symbol scan, or per-candidate filesystem probe. Emit resolvable `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, hierarchy; `DEPENDS_ON` spec-only.

### Registry, imports, facts
- Registry dynamically maps adapter `extensions()`: `register`, `getAdapter`, `getAdapterForFile`, `getLanguageForFile`, `getAdapters`; TypeScript default. Unknown extension: silently skip, no `FileNode`. Generic pipeline contains no language branches.
- `ImportDeclaration`: `localName`, `originalName`, `specifier`, `isRelative`. TS/Python relative iff starts `.`; Go/PHP always false. Parse only in `analyzeFile`.
- Extract deterministic lexical scopes; typed params/properties; construction; receivers; deterministic aliases; types; registry-recognized framework bindings. Common pipeline owns lookup/shadowing/filtering.
- `CALLS`: innermost function/method/arrow caller; resolve local/import/receiver/session candidates. Drop top-level, globals, ambiguous/dynamic. Drop runtime/reflection/container/monkey-patch/dynamic paths/interprocedural alias flow; may diagnostics only.

### Semantics + coverage
- Detect only source/import/manifest/qualified-map/deterministic-framework evidence. Heuristics never persist relations without deterministic evidence.
- Emit resolvable `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; normalize only semantically safe constructs; drop unresolvable/distorting constructs.
- Every built-in satisfies common facts, references, ranges, coverage, capability contracts; language specs authoritative. Capability true only with shared facts + ordered provenance sufficient for generic proof; otherwise explicit unsupported coverage.
- Use shared logical-symbol, binding, symbol-space, member-form, ranges, hierarchy, provenance, coverage vocabulary. No adapter syntax leaks. Built-in specialization spec covers language/extension, syntax, ownership, scopes, hierarchy, package/build, relations, unsupported boundary.
- Member-capable adapter: logical declaring owner before member identity; top-level no owner; distinct same-name owners. Emit `MemberSemantics` (`kind`, `dispatch`, `accessor`, optional `nativeKind`), never retired form; owner syntax sets occurrence `parentId`, top-level omits.
- Parse human/native member refs into structured owner→member candidates (0/1/many); canonical/structured bypass parse; no `.` split inside shared domain; dynamic/ambiguous unresolved. Render generic + optional native spelling.
- Hierarchy capability requires shared facts + ordered provenance allowing ancestor/embedded/composed/contract member lookup; consistent `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES`. Supported resolvable syntax with empty evidence = violation; unsupported/dynamic = explicit gap.
- Every built-in symbol: full construct `range` + declared-name `selectionRange`, half-open and contained; parser-derived; omit unverifiable range and report gap.

### Packages, re-exports
- `getPackageIdentity` upward from `codeRoot`, bounded `repoRoot` (CLI/MCP VCS `rootDir()`; filesystem root if absent): TS `package.json.name`, Python `[project].name` only (single/double TOML strings; absent continues), Go `go.mod module`, PHP `composer.json.name`. Manifest listed only if read. Optional; missing→undefined. Only `getPackageIdentity` / `resolveQualifiedNameToPath?` may I/O.
- Indexer builds package→workspace map; resolution uses session. `resolveQualifiedNameToPath?` manifest/autoloader metadata compact run cache; PHP shared lookup for CakePHP/CodeIgniter/namespace dynamic targets, no O(N) scan.
- Re-export resolves relative source or package identity + public entry map. TS uses `package.json` name + `exports`/`main`, `.js`→source; `@specd/code-graph` `exports["."]`→`dist/public.js`; `@specd/code-graph/internal` `exports["./internal"]`→`dist/index.js`. Emit re-exporting surface + entry-file published `targetId`; never guessed symbol; exactly one entry required. Adapter persists facts; indexer reads no package routes/copies no bindings.

## Constraints

- Plain compact cache/state; no side effects outside session; no `@specd/core`.
- Only exact deterministic syntax/semantic coverage; unsupported silently dropped or recorded coverage; no fuzzy/runtime inference.
- Tree-sitter/ast-grep patterns internal, never public API.
- Loader API registry-extensible; non-literal `require`/`include`/loader targets dropped; no file `DEPENDS_ON` fallback.
